issue_templates.name: Feature Request
issue_templates.description: Propose a new feature or change to Kintsu

sections.label: Problem Statement
sections.description: What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?
sections.placeholder: Describe the problem or limitation in the current system that motivates this feature.

sections.label: Motivation
sections.description: Why is this feature important? What use cases does it enable?
sections.placeholder:
- Who benefits from this feature?
- What use cases does it enable?
- How does it improve the developer experience?

sections.label: Proposed Solution
sections.description: Describe your proposed solution at a high level
sections.placeholder: How should this feature work? What would the API/syntax look like?

sections.label: Examples
sections.description: Provide concrete examples demonstrating the feature

sections.label: Alternatives Considered
sections.description: What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposal better?
sections.placeholder: Describe alternative solutions and why they were not chosen

sections.label: Impact Analysis
sections.description: What is the impact of this feature on existing functionality?

sections.label: Affected Components
sections.description: Which components of Kintsu does this feature affect?

sections.label: Specification Requirements
sections.description: Which specifications will be needed? (Maintainers will create these if accepted)

sections.label: Additional Context
sections.description: Any other information that would help evaluate this proposal
sections.placeholder: Links to related issues, external resources, or implementation notes

issue_templates.name: Specification Tracking
issue_templates.description: Track the progress of a specification (RFC, TSY, SPEC, ERR, AD) through review and implementation

sections.label: Specification ID
sections.description: The specification identifier (e.g., RFC-0032, SPEC-0024, TSY-0015)

sections.label: Related Feature Request
sections.description: Link to the original feature request issue

sections.label: Specification Type
sections.description: What type of specification is this?

sections.label: Current Status
sections.description: What is the current status of this specification?

sections.label: Specification Summary
sections.description: Brief summary of what this specification defines
sections.placeholder: This RFC defines the design and rationale for...

sections.label: Working Branch
sections.description: The branch where this specification is being developed

sections.label: Pull Request
sections.description: Link to the PR for this specification (if opened)

sections.label: Review Checklist
sections.description: Items that must be completed before advancing to 'proposed' status

options.label: Specification follows the template structure for its type
Cross-references to related specs are included
Frontmatter is complete (author, components, version_after, etc.)
Code blocks use expressive-code markers where appropriate

sections.label: Approval Checklist
sections.description: Items that must be completed before advancing to 'accepted' status

sections.label: Related Specifications
sections.description: Which companion specifications are needed?

sections.label: Implementation Notes
sections.description: Notes about implementation status or dependencies

sections.label: Timeline
sections.description: Expected timeline for completion

sections.label: Additional Notes
sections.description: Any other relevant information
sections.placeholder: Notes about design decisions, open questions, or blockers
